_why: Guard invariant 6b covers maps/ as of Task 137 (2026-08-03). The served set is DERIVED from what the pages actually fetch, so a file becomes legitimate the moment code asks for it — no list to maintain. These entries are the artifacts that already sat in the published tree when the guard was extended: each is recorded WITH ITS REASON rather than excused by a pattern, so a new stray still fails loudly. Removing them is the same move Task 137 made for seed_bindings.json and needs the same ruling; until then the guard is honest about what ships.
